day_shape: 66 items: IDF strike near Kfar Tebnit kills a Lebanese army brigadier general and two soldiers, IDF evacuation orders for five southern Lebanese villages, Witkoff–Kushner reported consulting Oak Ridge experts on Iran nuclear file, heavy Khamenei/IRIB Imam Khomeini anniversary cycle, two convicted in London over stabbing of Iranian dissident journalist.

threads.label: IDF strike kills Lebanese army officers
threads.summary: The IDF said it struck a vehicle near Kfar Tebnit in southern Lebanon after identifying it moving suspiciously in an evacuated combat zone, and said the incident is under review. The Lebanese Armed Forces said a brigadier general, a captain and a soldier were killed on a road between Kfar Tebnit and Khardali.

threads.label: South Lebanon evacuation orders and Beirut response
threads.summary: IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued an urgent evacuation order to residents of Armati, Mishghara, Kafr Houna, Sejd (Jezzine) and Ansariyeh, citing Hezbollah ceasefire violations. Defa Press reported Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Baghaei condemning Israeli actions across Lebanon, and Iran and Yemen rejecting Lebanese President Joseph Aoun's remarks on Hezbollah's Sheikh Naim Qassem.

threads.label: US–Iran nuclear track and Gulf posture
threads.summary: The Jerusalem Post cited an Axios report that Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner consulted technical experts at Oak Ridge National Laboratory on Thursday on the Iran nuclear file, and Times of Israel reported US and Iranian forces trading fire in the Gulf. CENTCOM posted imagery of US sailors and Marines rappelling from an MH-60S aboard USS Tripoli in the Arabian Sea.

threads.label: Tehran ceasefire and retaliation messaging
threads.summary: Defa Press carried an Iranian foreign ministry statement accusing the United States of repeated ceasefire violations and pledging defence of sovereignty, alongside an IRGC statement claiming missile strikes on the Ali Al-Salem base in Kuwait and Fifth Fleet facilities in Bahrain. Adviser Velayati and parliamentary spokesperson Rezaei were quoted asserting Iran will not show restraint against regional disorder.

threads.label: Khamenei Imam Khomeini anniversary cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published successive items marking the 37th anniversary of Ayatollah Khomeini's death, including a message on "rising for God" and a tree-diagram summary of warnings about a "hybrid war" of doubt, fear and division. IRIB and Defa Press carried supporting material including Haddad-Adel's account of martyr Khaji and a Pezeshkian condolence message to the Pourzand family.

threads.label: Iranians abroad and dissidents
threads.summary: Iran International reported a British couple detained in Tehran's Evin prison remain on hunger strike over access restrictions, with one barely able to walk. Times of Israel reported two convictions in London over the stabbing of an Iranian dissident journalist, and reported Iran condemning US "discriminatory treatment" over World Cup visa refusals.

threads.label: Iran domestic unrest and border clash
threads.summary: Iran International reported high school student protests against exam and university entrance rules across about 20 provinces, with some gatherings met by violence and arrests. Defa Press reported Faraja border guard commander Brigadier Ali Akbar Javidan saying six members of a "terrorist group" were killed in an armed clash at the Zabol border post overnight.

events.summary_en:
Urgent Alert to residents of Lebanon in the following towns and villages: Armati, Mishghara, Kafr Houna, Sejd (Jezzine), Ansariyeh

In light of Hezbollah's terrorist violation of the ceasefire agreement, the Defence Army is compelled to act against it forcefully. The Defence Army does not intend to harm you.

Out of concern for your safety, you must evacuate your homes immediately and move to the north of the Litani River.

Anyone in the vicinity of Hezbollah operatives and its facilities and combat assets puts their life in danger!
